name: SeeConnect Rechenzentrum Konstanz
notes: Official SeeConnect page describes a data center in Konstanz am Bodensee with more than 120 sqm of IT area; DataCenterMap lists Stadtwerke Konstanz SeeConnect at Max-Stromeyer-Strasse 21-29, 78467 Konstanz.

name: Regio-RZ Süd / badenIT data center Weil am Rhein-Haltingen
developer: Regio-RZ Süd GmbH; badenIT; Zweckverband Breitbandversorgung Landkreis Lörrach
notes: County page says badenIT and the broadband association built a modern data center in Weil am Rhein-Haltingen, inaugurated July 14, 2022, operated via Regio-RZ Süd GmbH; direct fiber routes link Frankfurt, Zurich, Basel, and Freiburg.

name: Caritas-Krankenhaus Bad Mergentheim modular data center
developer: BBT-Gruppe / Caritas-Krankenhaus Bad Mergentheim; DC-Datacenter-Group general contractor
notes: Official district and hospital releases say construction started after groundbreaking in October 2025; 21 m x 7 m modular building with server room, electrical distribution, cooling, security, diesel backup, PV roof, expansion areas for AI; handover planned for Q1 2026; investment about EUR 3.6m.

name: University IT Mannheim (UNIT) data center
notes: DCD reports the university began work on a new 5,360 sqm UNIT building in Mannheim's A5 district along Bismarckstrasse, with completion expected by mid-2027; waste heat from the data center will be reused for heating/cooling.

name: euNetworks Mannheim
notes: DataCenterPlatform lists euNetworks Mannheim at Pfingstweidstrasse 16 with 400 sqm floorspace; DC Hub reports 3.0 MW and operational status; euNetworks official colocation page says it operates colocation in 18 German data centers.

name: MTI/GLH MHG01
notes: Inflect lists MHG01 as a colocation data center at 15 Hans-Thoma-Strasse, Mannheim, with 1.0 MW total power capacity and N+1 redundancy; DataCenterPlatform also lists the MTI/GLH Mannheim facility.

name: DATIS Data Center
notes: DATIS recruiting page describes the Mannheim company as providing highly available systems from data centers in the Rhine-Neckar area; WLW describes DATIS services from an ISO 27001-certified data center; DataCenterMap lists DATIS Data Center at Fraunhoferstrasse 15, Mannheim.

name: Zayo Mannheim
notes: Inflect lists Zayo Mannheim among Mannheim data centers. Zayo official material confirms distributed colocation/PoP data-center offerings along its fiber network, but a facility-specific Mannheim power figure was not found.

name: BADEN CLOUD Rechenzentrum Appenweier
developer: LEITWERK Rechenzentren Appenweier GmbH / E-Werk Mittelbaden
notes: Official BADEN CLOUD page says Appenweier meets TÜV level 3 high-availability data-center requirements; E-Werk Mittelbaden release says the Appenweier data center is supplied with certified green power and reports PUE around 1.4; LEITWERK reports 2025 average PUE below 1.3.

name: BADEN CLOUD Rechenzentrum Lahr
developer: LEITWERK Rechenzentren Appenweier/Lahr GmbH; Q-Fox Group; E-Werk Mittelbaden
notes: E-Werk Mittelbaden says the joint venture is building new capacity at startkLahr Airport & Business Park, a twin site about 50% larger than Appenweier, with about 600 sqm and space for circa 230 racks; public reports cite EUR 16m investment.

name: GmündCOM-Datacenter
notes: DataCenterMap lists GmündCOM-Datacenter at Bürgerstrasse 5, 73525 Schwäbisch Gmünd, with private cabinets, partial cabinets, individual servers, and remote hands; Schwäbisch Gmünd page describes it as a carrier-neutral colocation facility in the Ostalb region.
